description: An unlimited descriptor resolves to a match flagged unlimited with a zero allowance and unspecified unit, both for a value-qualified unlimited entry and for a key-only unlimited default applied to an arbitrary request value.

configs.name: config.yaml
configs.content:
domain: d
descriptors:
  - key: u
    value: uv
    rate_limit:
      unlimited: true
  - key: u2
    rate_limit:
      unlimited: true

cases.expected_output:
matched=true
full_key=d.u_uv
requests_per_unit=0
unit=UNKNOWN
unlimited=true
shadow_mode=false
